_readme: Vendor rulebook for categorize.py. Rules are tried IN ORDER; the first regex (case-insensitive) that matches
the cleaned merchant OR the raw description wins. Fields: name, pattern, category, brand (optional),
note (optional), review (true = still send to the review queue even though it matched).
review.py --learn appends new rules here from your decisions; keep specific rules ABOVE generic ones.

rules.name: income tax payments (IRS / FTB)
rules.pattern: usataxpymt|irs tax payment|internal revenue service|franchise tax bo|franchise tax board|ftb payment|estimated tax
rules.note: owner's income tax on pass-through profit — excluded, P&L is pre-tax. CA $800 minimum franchise tax is immaterial inside this.
